Most downloaded Claude skills are built for a single task, but real work is a sequence of connected processes. In this video, we'll show you how to stop using skills in isolation and avoid building bloated "mega-skills". You'll learn the framework for building Skill Systems: modular, focused skills chained together into powerful, end-to-end automations that solve real business problems.
